description.en:
SAO YUI project
An AI chat companion in the style of Yui (MHCP001). Set up your own API in Cardinal System.

1.1.0:
- Chat in its own SAO message panel window: move it by its title or by Yui, resize it, click to close
- Yui's Heart Crystal: a collapsed form that changes color with CPU / GPU / memory load, with a speech bubble
- Desktop actions: Yui can start programs, find files (Everything) and close programs, always after your confirmation
- Yui's Heart window: add and edit memories, choose how much is remembered and sent, export / import / daily backups
- System Console, more settings with ↺ to restore each one, settings take effect at once
- Up / down in the input box bring back your earlier messages

1.0.0:
- Supports OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Kimi, Claude and custom servers, with streaming replies
- Remembers the conversation and what you tell her (Yui's Heart)
- Expressions, navigation pixie form, standby / wake up, welcome-back greeting
- Care reminders late at night and after long sessions, battery / CPU / memory warnings
- Opens links and searches for you after confirmation
- SAO-style settings (Cardinal System / Equipment), localizable interface
description.zh:
SAO YUI 计划
实在是很想要一个YUI,但是没人做,只能自己搓一个了,全Ai编程,本体就是个AI套壳.需要自己设置api.
有意见可以反馈,但是我不一定能改出来orz.

1.1.0 更新:
- 聊天界面独立成 SAO 消息面板窗口:可拖动标题或结衣移动,可调大小,点击关闭
- 结衣之心水晶:新的收起形态,随 CPU / GPU / 内存负载变色,并会在旁边冒出对话气泡
- 桌面代行:结衣可以帮你启动程序、查找文件(Everything)、关闭程序,每次都会先请你确认
- 结衣之心窗口:添加和编辑记忆,调整记住和发送的内容,导出 / 导入 / 每日备份
- System Console、更多可调设置(每项都能用 ↺ 恢复默认),设置即时生效
- 输入框按上 / 下键可以找回之前发过的消息

1.0.0 更新:
- 支持 OpenAI、Gemini、DeepSeek、Kimi、Claude 和自定义服务,回复逐字显示
- 记住对话内容和你告诉她的事(结衣之心)
- 表情切换、导航妖精形态、待机与唤醒、回来时的问候
- 深夜和长时间使用时的关心提醒,电量/CPU/内存警告
- 确认后帮你打开网页或搜索
- SAO 风格的设置界面(Cardinal System / Equipment),界面支持多语言

title.zh: 结衣 · 结衣之心水晶
